source: PaperTrade(resolved|closed, isDemo=0, 0<entryPrice<1) JOIN DecisionJournal JOIN ObservedTrade
dedupe: first entry per (bot, wallet, market, outcome)

targets.pnl_net_full: realizedPnl - entry fee - exit fee for status='closed' (all-taker upper bound)

fee_model: shares * rate * p * (1-p); entry always, exit only when status='closed'; rate by slug/question keyword (crypto .07, politics/finance .04, else .05)
